description:
"I'm not going to let them know I'm an Omega!"   
Edgar Seymour, a student at the University of Somerset and son of the foundation president and trustee of one of the world's most important elites and sole heir to the Duke of Seymour, has a secret that must never be discovered. He's an Omega! To change the twisted world in which only alpha males can be heirs, he decided to lie and live like an alpha until he gets his grandfather's job. One day a crisis comes to Edgar, who is uneasy about imitating such a perfect alpha. Rumors have started to spread that there is Omega lurking in the Alpha dorm! In addition, Daniel Burton, the only scholar and alpha at the college, was exposed to the scent of an omega. "I smell an omega on you." Can Edgar keep the secret until the end?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55023695), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/keep_a_secret), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/297028690), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/dw1_sr_0012), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5148668), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=200185)
